intent: Diagnose six primary and eight secondary historical signal losses, test an additional spatial/spectral feature family from registered V and path that can reject control alerts without suppressing existing correctly localized signals.

split.note: Previously viewed historical audit; cannot claim prospective, independent or blind validation.

loss_diagnostic.source: R42A5 artifact all_scores.npz, authenticated JSON fit_lock and result
examine: Row-identical lost true-positive IDs and recovered false alert IDs
Group, route, weak status, Minimal margin M, frozen NOISE margin N, valid/missing mask
Signed distance to each R42A5 fit-locked threshold, path-independent shape feature correlations

shape_features.data: R42A common V array shape [rows,16,128], original registered receiver spectrogram; predicted path from R42A3B fixed-route archive. All hashes verified before computation.
shape_features.transforms: At 16 path positions compare path-bin intensities to eight fixed sidebands +/-3,5,8,12; median sideband and MAD. Compute seven predeclared features: median local ridge contrast/MAD, 25th-percentile ridge contrast/MAD, fraction epochs with contrast>1 MAD, path-bin versus shoulder (+/-1,+/-2) median contrast/MAD, epoch-to-epoch absolute contrast difference, fraction path near edge (<8 or >=120), and mean absolute path drift per bin. Clip each ratio to [-30,+30] and missing sidebands to zero with explicit no-valid flags.
shape_features.physical_claim: Feature diagnostics on same registered spectra are not independent optical/radio observation or source classification.

predictor.rule: Only begin from frozen original JANUS+NOISE alerts. Train one L2 logistic discriminator from spectral features plus existing signed JANUS and NOISE margins, route and noise score support; NO new routing. Fit only reference-positive correctly localized hits and reference false-alert rows from six FIT groups. Exclude injected positives with incorrect localization from classifier training, preserve output for all rows.
predictor.fit_lock: Threshold nextafter(min training score over all correctly localized original fit hits,-infinity) to retain 100% fit reference true positives; if no valid separability, fail closed. All original accepted rows outside this filter are retained unless confidently classified control. No per-group/calibration based on audit.

cross_validation.procedure: Leave-one-fit-group-out, fit 5 groups using fixed features/hyperparameters, lock score cutoff to preserve all training reference hits, report held-out fit-group positive loss and false-alert removal. No selection of model or thresholds from CV results.

audit.evaluate_once: Use fixed full-fit model and locked threshold on groups 7–11. Report exact lost IDs and weak IDs, 51 control baseline to <=35 target, 318 localized and 69 weak reference hit preservation. Compare historical locked R42A5 A 43/312/65 and B 43/310/65. A failure is a scientifically valid negative result.

gates.R42B_pointing: HOLD authentic antenna pointing and prospective independent custodian
gates.phase_after_failure: If historical fails, diagnose; do not tune on audit. Seek new independent groups/physical features, not a posthoc threshold.
